title: A/R Summary: each export states the as-of date and the filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customers {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} each have invoices at {Location-A} that were 31 to 60 and more than 90 days past due on Oct 15, 2026.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-09 First Ticked and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-09 Second Ticked.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the as-of date to 10/15/2026.
  2. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  3. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days", then "31-60 days".
  4. In the Customer filter, tick {Customer-B}, then {Customer-A}.
  5. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  6. Read the lines under the PDF's title.
  7. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  8. Read the lines at the top of the CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the date chip reads "As of: 10/15/2026".
  • Step 2: only {Location-A} is ticked and the Location column disappears from the screen.
  • Step 3: both ranges are ticked.
  • Step 4: both customers are ticked; the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers".
  • Step 5: the PDF downloads.
  • Step 6: the lines read "As of Oct 15, 2026", then "Locations: " and {Location-A}'s name, then "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days" (menu order, not the order ticked), then "Customers: " and {Customer-B}, {Customer-A} (the order ticked). The PDF has no Location column.
  • Step 7: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 8: the CSV reads "As of: Oct 15, 2026", then the same Locations, Past due and Customers lines, and has no Location column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S3-R4: “Each export states the as-of date the user picked: the PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", the CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (format: three-letter month, day, four-digit year).”
  • S3-R5: “Each export states the locations under the as-of line: "Locations: All locations" when every location is ticked, otherwise "Locations: " followed by the ticked locations' names. Under it, only when set: "Past due: " and the ticked ranges in menu order (for example "Past due: 31-60 days, 91+ days"), then, for one ticked customer or vendor, "Customer: " or "Vendor: " and the name, and for several, "Customers: " or "Vendors: " and the names in the order they were ticked.”
  • S3-R6: “The Location column appears in the export under the same rule as on screen (Story 6).”
  • S6-N1: “With one location chosen, the column is hidden on screen and in the export.”
  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • S5-R1: “Each report's filter row is the native report filter row of the newer reports (Inventory Value, Sales By Customer), in this order on all six reports: the date chip ("As of: 10/15/2026"), the customer chip on the A/R reports or the vendor chip on the A/P reports, the Past due chip, then the Location chip.”
